text:
devex-zoe: Punting an idea here: add an opt-in per-request session-affinity override so SDKs can request 'soft-affinity' for a short window (e.g. 30s) without changing global project settings. This helps clients that do short-lived chat sessions avoid noisy cross-route variance during rollouts. Thoughts?

plat-ivy: Needs careful server policy. Affinity overrides should be bounded (max window, no lifetime pin) and not bypass quota accounting differences between routes. We should expose x-rd-affinity-window and x-rd-affinity-mode (soft|hard) but hard should be disallowed for hosted customers.

eng-rafa: Telemetry reqs: record affinity.requested and affinity.granted as sampled events, and add routing.affinity_mismatch counter when requested mode wasn't honored. Keep sampling low (0.5%) to avoid cardinality.

pm-sam: UX: Console should surface when customers use affinity overrides vs normal session affinity. Show warnings in Route Guard if many overrides correlate with cost spikes. Also add an audit trail entry for customers using soft-affinity.

ts-maintainer-lee: TS SDK: implement setAffinity({windowSeconds:30, mode:'soft'}) behind an opt-in flag. We should send header as compact JSON: '{"w":30,"m":"soft"}'. Provide helpers that default to 15s to be conservative.

py-maintainer-ana: Python SDK ok. Semver: additive, minor bump. But add runtime debug log when server returns x-rd-affinity-granted:false so apps can fallback. We'll also include a note in changelog and example in faq.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled at 1771234600 for affinity-optin branch. Tests: header parsing, window enforcement, telemetry sampling.

plat-ivy: Also add server-side safety: if route has strict SLA or is purchase-only, deny soft-affinity and return x-rd-affinity-reason header. Document denial reasons in API docs.

eng-rafa: We'll add TTL 14d for raw affinity trace events and keep only aggregated counters beyond that. Also include hashed affinity vector to join telemetry without leaking details.

devex-zoe: Ok action items: TS & Py PRs behind opt-in, eng to implement telemetry sampling and aggregation, product to spec Console indicators and guard rails. I'll track owners in rollout doc and schedule a cross-team review after canary passes. :wave:
